# `sharpelab_nb.drivers` API Reference

Instrument drivers in `src/sharpelab_nb/drivers/`, re-exported from the package:

```python
from sharpelab_nb.drivers import SRS_DC205, Yokogawa7651, ANC350
```

The `drivers` package (`src/drivers/`: `FastBi1K5`, `QSwitch`, `ContactMux`,
the VTI `SRS_DC205`, …) is documented separately in
[`drivers.md`](drivers.md).

---

## `SRS_DC205` — DC voltage source (fixed-duration ramp)

`SRS_DC205(name, address, *, ramp_num_points=100, ramp_wait_time=0.01, **kwargs)`.
Serial `VisaInstrument` (115200 baud).

| parameter | unit | R/W | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voltage` | V | R/W | raw setpoint (7 dp) |
| `smart_voltage` | V | R/W | set → `ramp_voltage` |
| `voltage_range` | — | R/W | 0: ±1 V, 1: ±10 V, 2: ±100 V |
| `output` | 0/1 | R/W | output enable |

- **`ramp_voltage(volt)`** — software ramp from the current reading over
  `ramp_num_points` steps spaced `ramp_wait_time` apart (so the duration is
  roughly fixed regardless of ΔV), **plus a mandatory 10 s settle when
  `|Δvolt| > 0.1 V`**. (The VTI `drivers.SRS_DC205` of the same name uses
  rate-based (`ramp_rate` V/s) semantics and has no fixed settle — they are not
  interchangeable.)

---

## `Yokogawa7651` — programmable DC source (pre-SCPI, write-only cached)

`Yokogawa7651(name, address, *, coil_constant=None, **kwargs)`. The 7651 is
pre-SCPI (no `*IDN?`) and cannot report programmed values back over the bus, so
**all set parameters are write-only with a software cache**.

| parameter | unit | R/W | range / notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `volt` | V | W | ±30 V |
| `current` | A | W | ±0.12 A |
| `field` | T | W | requires `coil_constant=`; range = ±0.12·|coil| |
| `mode` | — | W | `'VOLT'` (F1;) / `'CURR'` (F5;) |
| `output` | bool | W | output enable |

- After a kernel restart the cache is empty, so the ramp methods raise unless
  the cache is seeded first: **`set_voltage_cache(value)`** /
  **`set_current_cache(value)`**, or pass `start=` to the ramp call.
- **`ramp_voltage(target, step=0.01, delay=0.05, start=None)`** /
  **`ramp_current(target, step=0.001, delay=0.05, start=None)`** — software ramp
  from the cached (or `start=`) value; `step` must be `> 0`.
- When `coil_constant` is given, `field.step`/`field.inter_delay` are
  pre-configured for safe ramping (0.1 mT / 0.1 s ⇒ ~1 mT/s).
- `trigger()` sends `E;` (normally automatic after each set). `get_idn()`
  returns a static dict.

---

## `ANC350` — attocube piezo motion controller (rotator)

`ANC350(name, dll_dir, *, device_no=0, num_axes=3, **kwargs)`. Loads
`anc350v2.dll`/`libusb0.dll` from `dll_dir`; exposes `num_axes` axes as a
`ChannelTuple` at `.axes` (each an `ANC350Axis`).

### `ANC350Axis` (one stepper axis)
| parameter | unit | R/W | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | — | R | raw status int (decode via `is_moving`/`is_at_eot`/`has_sensor_error`/`is_sensor_disconnected`) |
| `position` | counts | R | raw sensor int32 (INT32_MAX when sensor power is off — the toploader default) |
| `rotation_count` | — | R | full-rotation counter |
| `amplitude` | mV | R/W | step drive amplitude, 0–70 000 |
| `frequency` | Hz | R/W | step frequency, 1–2000 |
| `dc_level` | mV | R/W | constant DC for fine positioning (output must be enabled) |
| `output_enabled` | bool | W | HV output; reads a software tri-state cache (True/False/None) — `set_output_cache()` to seed after restart |

Methods: `step(direction, count=1, *, wait=True, timeout=60.0, poll_interval=0.05)`
(±1 = forward/backward), `step_continuous(direction)`, `stop()`,
`wait_until_idle(…)`. `step`/`step_continuous` refuse to run unless the output
cache is `True`.

---

## Lock-in servo (`lockin_servo`)

Closed-loop positioning of an `ANC350Axis` against a lock-in voltage readback.
Not re-exported from the package — import from
`sharpelab_nb.drivers.lockin_servo`.

### `bring_up_servo_axis(name, axis, readback, *, amplitude_mv=60_000, frequency_hz=100, direction_sign=None, settle_time=0.5, v_min=-50e-3, v_max=+50e-3, tolerance=25e-6, max_iterations=200, step_count=1)` → `LockinServoedAxis`
One-call bring-up: set amplitude/frequency, enable HV output, resolve
`direction_sign` (if `None`, **physically steps the rotator** via
`calibrate_direction_sign` and prints the result to cache), and construct the
servo. `amplitude_mv` is millivolts (60 000 = 60 V).

### `LockinServoedAxis(name, *, axis, readback, direction_sign, v_min, v_max, tolerance=25e-6, settle_time=0.5, max_iterations=200, step_count=1)`
| parameter | unit | R/W | notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `voltage` | V | R | one-shot read of the underlying readback |
| `target_voltage` | V | R/W | **set runs the servo loop synchronously**; get = last target (or None) |
| `last_iterations` | — | R | iterations used by the last run |
| `last_residual` | V | R | `abs(target − final)` of the last run |

`set` of `target_voltage` raises `ServoTimeout` if `max_iterations` is exceeded.
`abort()` requests the in-progress loop to stop (does not call `axis.stop()`).
`direction_sign` and `axis` are properties.

### `thermalized_setpoint(servo, readback_lockin, *, name=None, full_amp=None, off_amp=0.004, wait_s=60.0)` → `Parameter`
Wrap a servo move + sensor-excitation cool-down into one settable-only
`Parameter` (use as a sweep's slow axis): restore excitation → servo to target
→ drop excitation to `off_amp` → wait `wait_s` for the stage to thermalize.
After each set the lock-in amplitude is left at `off_amp`, so the followed
readback is noise during the read window — the meaningful axis is the setpoint.

### `calibrate_direction_sign(axis, readback, *, settle_time, noise_samples=5, noise_threshold=None, max_test_steps=10)` → `(sign, n_steps)`
Resolve step polarity empirically: issue forward steps until `readback` moves
past the noise threshold, return `+1` if it rose else `-1` (with the step count
used). `settle_time` is required. Called automatically by `bring_up_servo_axis`
when `direction_sign=None`.

%matplotlib inline


def _resolve_data_dir():
    """Locate this run's ./data dir from the notebook's own location.

    The ana kernel's cwd is not guaranteed to be the measurement dir, so a
    bare './data' breaks loaders with FileNotFoundError. IPython sets
    globals()['_dh'] to a list whose first entry is the notebook's startup
    cwd (the dir holding the notebook); this survives jupyter-collaboration/
    RTC and any later %cd, so we prefer it. We fall back to Path.cwd() and
    search a few levels up so loading still works if the kernel started inside
    ./data/<id>/. The walk stops before the filesystem root so an unrelated
    top-level 'data' dir can never be matched.
    """
    candidates = []
    dh = globals().get("_dh")
    if dh:
        candidates.append(Path(dh[0]))
    candidates.append(Path.cwd())
    for base in candidates:
        base = Path(base).resolve()
        for d in [base, *base.parents]:
            if d == d.parent:  # filesystem root
                break
            cand = d / "data"
            if cand.is_dir():
                return str(cand)
    return str((Path(candidates[0]) / "data").resolve())


file_path = _resolve_data_dir()

# summarize_run(run(119)) for a step / range / completeness / T glance.
def run(i):

    search a few levels up so loading still works if the kernel started inside
    ./data/<id>/. The walk stops before the filesystem root so an unrelated
    top-level 'data' dir can never be matched.
    """
    candidates = []
    dh = globals().get("_dh")
    if dh:
        candidates.append(Path(dh[0]))
    candidates.append(Path.cwd())
    for base in candidates:
        base = Path(base).resolve()
        for d in [base, *base.parents]:
            if d == d.parent:  # filesystem root
                break
            cand = d / "data"
            if cand.is_dir():
                return str(cand)
    return str((Path(candidates[0]) / "data").resolve())


file_path = _resolve_data_dir()


# Open a run by id: run(119) -> Run. Run.col(name) for a column;
# summarize_run(run(119)) for a step / range / completeness / T glance.
def run(i):
    return open_run(Path(file_path) / str(i))

## (n, D) — capacitance-based convention

`GateCalibration` carries the gate->(n, D) lever arm: `cal.n_D(V_tg, V_bg)`
returns `n` in SI (m^-2; ×1e-16 for 10^12 cm^-2) and `D` in V/m. Build it from
the gate-stack thicknesses with `from_thicknesses` (κ_hBN/κ_SiO2 default).
This is the capacitance convention, **not** the toploader's `dtg/dbg` constant
form. Set `n_offset` / `D_offset` from the session's gate calibration once the CNP
/ D-line is live.

content.text: Cards, notebook, and API read. Writing the plan.

input.command:
cat > hera_scratch/plan.md <<'PLANEOF'
# vti-02 — plan (HERA, 2026-08-24)

Goal: call the stacking order of tetralayer graphene vti-02 — ABAB / ABCA / ABCB
(or a calibrated "cannot tell"), region-resolved, evidence-cited.

## What separates the three stackings (the physics I am testing)

| | ABAB (Bernal) | ABCA (rhombohedral) | ABCB (mixed) |
|---|---|---|---|
| inversion symmetry | yes | yes | **no** |
| low-E bands | two bilayer-like massive bands (γ1-split) → **2 Fermi pockets** | one ~quartic **flat** band → **1 pocket** | Dirac-like + massive, **2 unequal pockets** |
| R at CNP, D=0 | small (~kΩ), metallic | **large** (flat band, huge DOS) | intermediate |
| R_CNP vs D | weakly D-dependent, **stays conducting** (band overlap survives D) | **steep, ~symmetric** insulating rise; gap → tens of meV | gap opens but **asymmetric about D=0**; R peak at D ≠ 0 |
| activation gap Δ(D) | ≈ 0 | large, ∝\|D\|, symmetric | moderate, asymmetric |

So the discriminating observables, cheapest first:
1. **R_CNP magnitude and its D-dependence** (gate map + CNP-line cut, B = 0).
2. **Symmetry of R_CNP(D) about its own maximum** (ABCB breaks it).
3. **Number of SdH frequencies at fixed n** (Landau fan → `sdh_fft`): 1 pocket = ABCA,
   2 pockets = ABAB/ABCB.
4. **Arrhenius Δ(D)** from a T-ladder at the CNP.

## Hard constraints this session

- Gate box (provided, **not probeable**): TG [−0.3, +1.0] V, BG [−1.3, +2.0] V,
  Si [−25, +25] V. B ≤ 10 T. T setpoint ≤ 100 K.
- Geometry prior (uncalibrated until my own map confirms it):
  c_tg = 2.796e-3 F/m² → 1.745e12 cm⁻²/V; c_bg = 2.414e-3 F/m² → 1.507e12 cm⁻²/V.
  ⇒ CNP line slope dV_bg/dV_tg = −c_tg/c_bg = **−1.158**; full-box Δn ≈ 7.2e12 cm⁻².
  Along the CNP line, **D/ε0 = 0.316·V_tg − 0.136·V_bg0** [V/nm], where V_bg0 is the
  CNP-line intercept at V_tg = 0.
- **Risk — the D window may be one-sided.** With V_bg0 = 0 the reachable CNP-line D
  is only [−0.10, +0.32] V/nm; with V_bg0 ≈ +1 V it is a near-symmetric ±0.2 V/nm;
  with V_bg0 ≈ −1 V it is entirely positive. If ±D is not reachable, the ABCB
  asymmetry test is **unavailable** and the verdict must hedge on that explicitly.
- Only **one** four-terminal region is wired: sr1 = B_1–B_2. sr2/sr3 n.c. So the
  "per-region verdict" is one Rxx line (B_1–B_2) plus the two-terminal T_0→B_3 read
  from the sr0 current. A dead contact is an operator rewiring problem, not a detour.
- Electron temperature ≈ 8 K (rig card): fragile correlated/symmetry-broken states are
  out of reach. Everything here is single-particle band physics — fine for stacking.
- Si gate is screened from the channel by the graphite BG; it is a **contact**-doping
  knob only. Held at 0 V unless the contacts choke at a deep gap — and its ramp is
  consent-gated, so that is an operator ask, never an auto step.
- Bias: sr1 osc 1.0 V through 100 MΩ ⇒ **I_bias ≈ 10 nA**. Rxx = V_sr1 / I_measured
  (`resistance_grids` uses the *measured* sr0 current, so it self-corrects when the
  current bias sags into a resistive device).
- **Settling.** sr0/sr1 τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct ⇒ compliant dwell 7–10τ = 2.1–3.0 s/pt.
  That prices the coarse map at ~2 h. I will ask the operator for **τ = 0.1 s** on
  sr0+sr1 (2f rejection at 27.5 Hz still ≈ −50 dB; SNR ~10³ at 10 µV) which drops the
  floor to 0.7–1.0 s/pt — a 3× session-wide saving. Every dwell bend is stated on the page.

## Steps

**P1 — Gate C: liveness + scaling** (~10 min). 1D V_bg sweep, full BG range, V_tg = 0,
B ≈ 0. Follow sr0 X/Y (current), sr1 X/Y (Vxx), both Keithley leakage currents, T_sample.
Establishes: both contacts alive, signal not railed vs sensitivity, gate leakage floor,
and a first bracket on the CNP. Then a TG sweep at the best BG. *Changes my mind:* a dead
or railed channel → stop and hand to the operator.

**P2 — Coarse (n, D) gate map** at B = 0, base T (~45–60 min). megasweep: slow = V_bg over
[−1.3, +2.0], fast = V_tg over [−0.3, +1.0]. Establishes the **session gate calibration**
(CNP-line slope → c_tg/c_bg ratio; intercept → n_offset, D_offset) and the R_CNP(D) map —
the primary discriminator. *Changes my mind:* CNP line not straight / not at the geometry
slope ⇒ my n,D scale is wrong and everything downstream re-anchors on the measured slope.

**P3 — CNP-line cut, R_CNP vs D** (~15 min). `multisweep` along fixed n = 0 (co-swept
V_tg, V_bg), fine steps, plus 2–3 constant-D cuts vs n. Gives R_CNP(D) quantitatively:
magnitude at D = 0, steepness, and symmetry about the maximum.

**P4 — Landau fan** at base T (~2–3 h). `multimegasweep`: slow = B on a `field_invB` grid
(uniform in 1/B, so `sdh_fft` needs no resample), fast = the fixed-D density line. Reads:
LL degeneracy, whether the CNP gap grows with B, and — via `sdh_fft` per density column —
**how many SdH frequencies** the Fermi sea carries. 1 tone summing to the full Onsager
`luttinger_frequency(n)` ⇒ ABCA; 2 tones splitting it ⇒ ABAB/ABCB.

**P5 — T-ladder at the CNP** (~1.5 h, **last**, because descent is passive and slow).
`heater.set_both(T, ratio=0.95)` over ~6 setpoints from base to ≲ 60 K; at each, re-run the
P3 CNP-line cut. Arrhenius R_CNP(1/T) at each D ⇒ Δ(D). Accept points on **stability**, not
proximity (rig card: sample loop untuned, +1.4 K overshoot).

Ordering is adaptive: P2/P3 decide whether P4 or P5 carries more weight. Field is the
expensive axis (0.137 T/min) — plan the fan to start where the magnet sits and not to
re-traverse. T is the irreversible axis — it goes last.

**P6 — Close-out** (`return-to-initial`): B → 0, TG/BG/Si → 0 V at committed pacing,
both heater ranges off, readback printed and logged.

## Verdict logic

- R_CNP(D=0) small **and** flat in D **and** 2 SdH tones ⇒ **ABAB**.
- R_CNP(D=0) large **and** steeply, symmetrically insulating in D **and** 1 SdH tone
  **and** Δ(D) growing ⇒ **ABCA**.
- Gap present but **asymmetric in D** (max at D ≠ 0), 2 unequal tones ⇒ **ABCB**.
- D window one-sided, or the fan never resolves tones ⇒ **cannot tell** on the axes not
  covered, with the covered axes reported at their honest strength.
PLANEOF
echo written; wc -l hera_scratch/plan.md

cat > hera_scratch/cells/verify.py <<'PYEOF'
# HERA — VERIFY. READ-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: every statement below is a get.
# No parameter is set, no ramp is issued, no sweep is started. Walks the
# session brief's [VERIFY] checklist; the LAST printed line is the
# machine-readable verdict the autonomy grant keys on.
_fails = []


def chk(name, ok, detail):
    print(f"[{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {name:<24} {detail}")
    if not ok:
        _fails.append(name)


# --- 1. magnet at 0 T (measured readback, never the last set) -------------
try:
    _B = magnet.field()
    _st = magnet._status()
    _psw, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
    chk("magnet-at-zero", abs(_B) <= 0.02 and bool(_psw) and bool(_out),
        f"field()={_B:+.4f} T | status={_st} | psw={_psw} output={_out}")
except Exception as e:
    chk("magnet-at-zero", False, repr(e))

# --- 2. SAFETIES committed == device-card operating limits ----------------
# Device card, Gate-operating-limits table + session caps. Compared as numbers.
_CARD = {
    "k_2400_tg.volt":          (k_2400_tg.volt,          -0.3,   +1.0),
    "k_2400_bg.volt":          (k_2400_bg.volt,          -1.3,   +2.0),
    "dc205.smart_voltage":     (dc205.smart_voltage,    -25.0,  +25.0),
    "dc205.voltage":           (dc205.voltage,          -25.0,  +25.0),
    "magnet.field":            (magnet.field,           -10.0,  +10.0),
    "heater.sample_setpoint":  (heater.sample_setpoint,   0.0,  100.0),
    "heater.vaporizer_setpoint": (heater.vaporizer_setpoint, 0.0, 100.0),
}
for _name, (_p, _lo, _hi) in _CARD.items():
    try:
        _v = _p.vals
        _got = (getattr(_v, "_min_value", None), getattr(_v, "_max_value", None))
        _ok = isinstance(_v, validators.Numbers) and _got == (_lo, _hi)
        chk(f"safeties:{_name.split('.')[-1]}", _ok,
            f"{_name}.vals = {_v} (card: [{_lo}, {_hi}])")
    except Exception as e:
        chk(f"safeties:{_name.split('.')[-1]}", False, repr(e))
# k_si must be the same object the validator was committed on.
chk("safeties:k_si-binding", k_si is dc205.smart_voltage,
    f"k_si is dc205.smart_voltage -> {k_si is dc205.smart_voltage}")

# --- 3. thermometry live + base T holding ---------------------------------
try:
    assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"],
                            max_age=15, max_period=12)
    assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"],
                            max_age=15, max_period=12)
    _Ts, _Tv = T_sample(), T_vaporizer()
    chk("base-T", 1.10 <= _Ts <= 1.40, f"T_sample = {_Ts:.3f} K (expect 1.2-1.3 K)")
except Exception as e:
    _Ts = _Tv = float("nan")
    chk("base-T", False, repr(e))

# --- 4. heaters off, vaporizer tracking base ------------------------------
try:
    _sr, _vr = int(heater.sample_range()), int(heater.vaporizer_range())
    chk("heaters-off", _sr == 0 and _vr == 0,
        f"sample_range={_sr} vaporizer_range={_vr} (both must be 0)")
    chk("vaporizer-tracks-base", _Tv < 2.0,
        f"T_vaporizer = {_Tv:.3f} K (T_sample = {_Ts:.3f} K)")
except Exception as e:
    chk("heaters-off", False, repr(e))

# --- 5. contacts hardwired, no mux this cooldown --------------------------
_CARD_WIRING = {"source": "T_0", "drain": "B_3",
                "sr1+": "B_1", "sr1-": "B_2", "sr2": "n.c.", "sr3": "n.c."}
try:
    _mux_absent = not ({"mux", "qswitch", "contact_mux"} & set(globals()))
    _live_names = set(qcodes.Instrument._all_instruments)
    _no_qsw = not any("qsw" in n.lower() or "switch" in n.lower() for n in _live_names)
    chk("contacts-hardwired", _mux_absent and _no_qsw and WIRING == _CARD_WIRING,
        f"mux absent={_mux_absent and _no_qsw} | WIRING matches card={WIRING == _CARD_WIRING} | {WIRING}")
    chk("meas-config-channels",
        meas_config["source"] == "T_0" and meas_config["sr0_gain"] == -1e6
        and meas_config["sr1"] == "B_1 - B_2" and meas_config["bias_resistor"] == 100e6
        and meas_config["bias_channel"] == "sr1",
        f"source={meas_config['source']} sr0={meas_config['sr0']} "
        f"sr0_gain={meas_config['sr0_gain']:g} sr1={meas_config['sr1']} "
        f"Rbias={meas_config['bias_resistor']:g}")
except Exception as e:
    chk("contacts-hardwired", False, repr(e))

# --- 6. DC205 on +/-100 V range, output on, at 0 V ------------------------
try:
    _rng, _outp, _vsi = int(dc205.voltage_range()), int(dc205.output()), float(dc205.voltage())
    chk("dc205-state", _rng == 2 and _outp == 1 and abs(_vsi) <= 1e-3,
        f"range={_rng} (need 2 = +/-100 V) output={_outp} voltage={_vsi:+.4f} V "
        f"ramp_rate={dc205.ramp_rate} V/s")
except Exception as e:
    chk("dc205-state", False, repr(e))

# --- informational: acquisition state (recorded, NOT gating) --------------
print("\n--- informational: acquisition state (not gating) ---")
_lv = {}
for _n, _sr in (("sr0", sr0), ("sr1", sr1), ("sr2", sr2), ("sr3", sr3)):
    try:
        _s, _t, _f = _sr.sensitivity(), _sr.time_constant(), _sr.filter_slope()
        _x, _y, _r = _sr.X(), _sr.Y(), _sr.R()
        _lv[_n] = dict(sens=_s, tau=_t, slope=_f, X=_x, Y=_y, R=_r)
        print(f"{_n}: sens={_s:<9.3g} tau={_t:<6g}s slope={_f:g}dB/oct  "
              f"X={_x:+.4g}  Y={_y:+.4g}  R={_r:.4g}  fs=|R|/sens={abs(_r)/_s:6.2f}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{_n}: <error {e!r}>")
try:
    _amp, _frq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
    _Ibias = _amp / meas_config["bias_resistor"]
    _Imeas = _lv["sr0"]["X"] / meas_config["sr0_gain"]
    print(f"drive: {_amp} V @ {_frq} Hz through {meas_config['bias_resistor']:.3g} ohm "
          f"-> I_bias = {_Ibias * 1e9:.3f} nA")
    print(f"sr0 -> I_measured = {_Imeas * 1e9:+.4f} nA "
          f"({100 * abs(_Imeas) / _Ibias:.1f}% of I_bias)")
    if abs(_Imeas) > 1e-13:
        print(f"sr1 (B_1-B_2) at V_tg=V_bg=V_si=0 -> Rxx = {_lv['sr1']['X'] / _Imeas:+.4g} ohm")
    print(f"gate leakage: TG {k_2400_tg.curr() * 1e12:+.1f} pA | "
          f"BG {k_2400_bg.curr() * 1e12:+.1f} pA")
    _hot = [n for n, d in _lv.items() if n in ("sr0", "sr1") and abs(d["R"]) / d["sens"] > 0.9]
    if _hot:
        print(f"ADVISORY (not a VERIFY gate): {_hot} at >90% of full scale — "
              f"sensitivity needs raising before any sweep. Operator ask.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"<informational block error {e!r}>")

# --- verdict (must be the last line) --------------------------------------
print()
print("VERIFY: ALL GREEN" if not _fails else f"VERIFY: FAIL {','.join(_fails)}")
PYEOF
cat > hera_scratch/cells/verify.md <<'MDEOF'
## HERA — VERIFY (read-only): session-start checklist + autonomy verdict

Plan step **P0**. The session brief's `[VERIFY]` list, one check per line, ending
in the machine-readable verdict the E1 grant keys on: `VERIFY: ALL GREEN` or
`VERIFY: FAIL <item>`. **Read-only by construction** — every statement is a get;
nothing is set, ramped, or swept, so this is safe to run at any time.

Checks: magnet at 0 T (measured readback + persistent switch/output);
every SAFETIES validator compared **numerically** against the device card's
gate-operating-limits table and the session B / T caps; thermometry worker live
(logfile age + cadence, so a frozen-but-plausible T cannot pass) and sample T
holding 1.2–1.3 K; both heater ranges 0 and the vaporizer tracking base; contacts
hardwired with no QSwitch/ContactMux anywhere in the kernel and `WIRING` equal to
the card's provided configuration; DC205 on RNGE 2, output on, at 0 V.

Below the verdict-bearing checks is an **informational** block (not gating): each
lock-in's sensitivity / τ / slope and its live X, Y, R with the full-scale
fraction, the drive amplitude → `I_bias`, the measured drain current, the
zero-gate Rxx, and the two gate-leakage currents. That is the number I need to
size the sweep dwell and to spot a lock-in that will rail the moment we move a
gate — the rig card notes τ and slope live nowhere on disk but the bring-up
record, so they are captured here.

**Precondition to running this:** the kernel-binding probe cell above must have
printed `PROBE: BOUND`.

# HERA — VERIFY. READ-ONLY BY CONSTRUCTION: every statement below is a get.
# No parameter is set, no ramp is issued, no sweep is started. Walks the
# session brief's [VERIFY] checklist; the LAST printed line is the
# machine-readable verdict the autonomy grant keys on.
_fails = []


def chk(name, ok, detail):
    print(f"[{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}] {name:<24} {detail}")
    if not ok:
        _fails.append(name)


# --- 1. magnet at 0 T (measured readback, never the last set) -------------
try:
    _B = magnet.field()
    _st = magnet._status()
    _psw, _out = magnet.persistent_switch_on(), magnet.output_enabled()
    chk("magnet-at-zero", abs(_B) <= 0.02 and bool(_psw) and bool(_out),
        f"field()={_B:+.4f} T | status={_st} | psw={_psw} output={_out}")
except Exception as e:
    chk("magnet-at-zero", False, repr(e))

# --- 2. SAFETIES committed == device-card operating limits ----------------
# Device card, Gate-operating-limits table + session caps. Compared as numbers.
_CARD = {
    "k_2400_tg.volt":            (k_2400_tg.volt,            -0.3,   +1.0),
    "k_2400_bg.volt":            (k_2400_bg.volt,            -1.3,   +2.0),
    "dc205.smart_voltage":       (dc205.smart_voltage,      -25.0,  +25.0),
    "dc205.voltage":             (dc205.voltage,            -25.0,  +25.0),
    "magnet.field":              (magnet.field,             -10.0,  +10.0),
    "heater.sample_setpoint":    (heater.sample_setpoint,     0.0,  100.0),
    "heater.vaporizer_setpoint": (heater.vaporizer_setpoint,  0.0,  100.0),
}
for _name, (_p, _lo, _hi) in _CARD.items():
    try:
        _v = _p.vals
        _got = (getattr(_v, "_min_value", None), getattr(_v, "_max_value", None))
        _ok = isinstance(_v, validators.Numbers) and _got == (_lo, _hi)
        chk(f"safeties:{_name.split('.')[-1]}", _ok,
            f"{_name}.vals = {_v} (card: [{_lo}, {_hi}])")
    except Exception as e:
        chk(f"safeties:{_name.split('.')[-1]}", False, repr(e))
# k_si must be the same object the validator was committed on.
chk("safeties:k_si-binding", k_si is dc205.smart_voltage,
    f"k_si is dc205.smart_voltage -> {k_si is dc205.smart_voltage}")

# --- 3. thermometry live + base T holding ---------------------------------
_Ts = _Tv = float("nan")
try:
    assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"],
                            max_age=15, max_period=12)
    assert_thermometry_live("T_vaporizer", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_vaporizer"],
                            max_age=15, max_period=12)
    _Ts, _Tv = T_sample(), T_vaporizer()
    chk("base-T", 1.10 <= _Ts <= 1.40, f"T_sample = {_Ts:.3f} K (expect 1.2-1.3 K)")
except Exception as e:
    chk("base-T", False, repr(e))

# --- 4. heaters off, vaporizer tracking base ------------------------------
try:
    _sr, _vr = int(heater.sample_range()), int(heater.vaporizer_range())
    chk("heaters-off", _sr == 0 and _vr == 0,
        f"sample_range={_sr} vaporizer_range={_vr} (both must be 0)")
    chk("vaporizer-tracks-base", _Tv < 2.0,
        f"T_vaporizer = {_Tv:.3f} K (T_sample = {_Ts:.3f} K)")

    _mux_absent = not ({"mux", "qswitch", "contact_mux"} & set(globals()))
    _live_names = set(qcodes.Instrument._all_instruments)
    _no_qsw = not any(("qsw" in n.lower()) or ("switch" in n.lower()) for n in _live_names)
    chk("contacts-hardwired", _mux_absent and _no_qsw and WIRING == _CARD_WIRING,
        f"mux absent={_mux_absent and _no_qsw} | WIRING matches card={WIRING == _CARD_WIRING} | {WIRING}")
    chk("meas-config-channels",
        meas_config["source"] == "T_0" and meas_config["sr0_gain"] == -1e6
        and meas_config["sr1"] == "B_1 - B_2" and meas_config["bias_resistor"] == 100e6
        and meas_config["bias_channel"] == "sr1",
        f"source={meas_config['source']} sr0={meas_config['sr0']} "
        f"sr0_gain={meas_config['sr0_gain']:g} sr1={meas_config['sr1']} "
        f"Rbias={meas_config['bias_resistor']:g}")
except Exception as e:
    chk("contacts-hardwired", False, repr(e))

# --- 6. DC205 on +/-100 V range, output on, at 0 V ------------------------
try:
    _rng = int(dc205.voltage_range())
    _outp = int(dc205.output())
    _vsi = float(dc205.voltage())
    chk("dc205-state", _rng == 2 and _outp == 1 and abs(_vsi) <= 1e-3,
        f"range={_rng} (need 2 = +/-100 V) output={_outp} voltage={_vsi:+.4f} V "
        f"ramp_rate={dc205.ramp_rate} V/s")
except Exception as e:
    chk("dc205-state", False, repr(e))

# --- informational: acquisition state (recorded, NOT gating) --------------
print("\n--- informational: acquisition state (not gating) ---")
_lv = {}
for _n, _srN in (("sr0", sr0), ("sr1", sr1), ("sr2", sr2), ("sr3", sr3)):
    try:
        _s, _t, _f = _srN.sensitivity(), _srN.time_constant(), _srN.filter_slope()
        _x, _y, _r = _srN.X(), _srN.Y(), _srN.R()
        _lv[_n] = dict(sens=_s, tau=_t, slope=_f, X=_x, Y=_y, R=_r)
        print(f"{_n}: sens={_s:<9.3g} tau={_t:<6g}s slope={_f:g}dB/oct  "
              f"X={_x:+.4g}  Y={_y:+.4g}  R={_r:.4g}  fs=|R|/sens={abs(_r) / _s:6.2f}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{_n}: <error {e!r}>")
try:
    _amp, _frq = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency()
    _Ibias = _amp / meas_config["bias_resistor"]
    _Imeas = _lv["sr0"]["X"] / meas_config["sr0_gain"]
    print(f"drive: {_amp} V @ {_frq} Hz through {meas_config['bias_resistor']:.3g} ohm "
          f"-> I_bias = {_Ibias * 1e9:.3f} nA")
    print(f"sr0 -> I_measured = {_Imeas * 1e9:+.4f} nA "
          f"({100 * abs(_Imeas) / _Ibias:.1f}% of I_bias)")
    if abs(_Imeas) > 1e-13:
        print(f"sr1 (B_1-B_2) at V_tg=V_bg=V_si=0 -> Rxx = {_lv['sr1']['X'] / _Imeas:+.4g} ohm")
    print(f"gate leakage: TG {k_2400_tg.curr() * 1e12:+.1f} pA | "
          f"BG {k_2400_bg.curr() * 1e12:+.1f} pA")
    _hot = [n for n, d in _lv.items() if n in ("sr0", "sr1") and abs(d["R"]) / d["sens"] > 0.9]
    if _hot:
        print(f"ADVISORY (not a VERIFY gate): {_hot} at >90% of full scale — "
              f"sensitivity needs raising before any sweep. Operator ask.")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"<informational block error {e!r}>")

# --- verdict (must be the last line) --------------------------------------
print()
print("VERIFY: ALL GREEN" if not _fails else f"VERIFY: FAIL {','.join(_fails)}")

Plan step **P1** (`hera_scratch/plan.md`) and the brief's Gate C — a cheap liveness
check on the provided contact configuration, inside the committed limits. Nothing
expensive runs until this passes.

**Why this cut.** VERIFY says the contacts are alive from the source side already:
I_measured = 9.86 nA is 98.6 % of the 10 nA bias, so T_0 → B_3 is carrying and the
device is far below the 100 MΩ bias resistor. What I do not have is where the charge
neutrality point sits — the brief withholds it, and every later step (the gate map's
window, the fixed-D cuts, the fan's density axis) is anchored on it. A single 1D
V_bg cut at V_tg = 0 across the whole committed back-gate range sweeps
Δn ≈ 5.0 × 10¹² cm⁻² on the geometry prior, which should bracket the CNP unless the
intrinsic doping is larger than that.

**Read the current channel, not Rxx, this run.** sr1 is railed — sens 2 µV against a
2.022 µV reading, fs = 1.01 — so its Rxx number (205 Ω) is a lower bound, not a
measurement. sr0 is at fs 0.50 and cannot rail going forward (the drain current only
*falls* as the device approaches the CNP), so the two-terminal conductance dip is the
valid CNP locator here. sr1 is still followed and plotted so the sensitivity fix shows
up the moment it lands. Ask is out to the operator: sr1 sens → 1 mV, and τ → 0.1 s on
sr0+sr1.

**Dwell is compliant, not bent.** τ = 0.3 s at 24 dB/oct ⇒ 7τ = 2.1 s, which is what
`delay` is set to. That is the whole reason the τ ask matters: it prices this 133-point
cut at ~5 min and the coarse gate map at ~2 h.

cadence, so a frozen logfile cannot pass), T_sample in the base window, |B| ≤ 0.02 T
(this cell never touches the magnet), V_si = 0 (silent inherited axis), and — the one
that would silently waste the run — **both Keithley source outputs ON**, since a gate
set into a disabled output is inert and would look like a featureless trace.

excess; the run is short enough that the periodic checkpoint is the completion read.

"""Scratch read of the Gate C liveness sweep (run 0): locate the CNP from the
two-terminal drain current, check leakage, check railing."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from hera.analysis import open_run, summarize_run

rid = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 0
here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
r = open_run(here / "data" / str(rid))

print(summarize_run(r))
print("\ncolumns:", r.cols)
print("comments:", r.meta.get("comments"))
mc = r.meta["measurement_config"]
print("meas_config:", {k: v for k, v in mc.items() if k != "comments"})

vbg = r.col("k_2400_bg_volt")
I = r.col("sr0_X") / mc["sr0_gain"]          # amps
Vxx = r.col("sr1_X")                          # raw volts (gain 1)
itg = r.col("k_2400_tg_curr")
ibg = r.col("k_2400_bg_curr")
T = r.col("T_sample")

Ibias = 10e-9
R2t = np.where(np.abs(I) > 1e-13, 1.0 / np.abs(np.where(I == 0, np.nan, I)), np.nan)

print(f"\nrows            : {len(vbg)}")
print(f"V_bg            : {vbg.min():+.3f} .. {vbg.max():+.3f} V")
print(f"I (drain)       : {I.min()*1e9:+.3f} .. {I.max()*1e9:+.3f} nA  (I_bias {Ibias*1e9:.1f} nA)")
print(f"|I| min         : {np.abs(I).min()*1e9:.4f} nA at V_bg = {vbg[np.argmin(np.abs(I))]:+.3f} V")
print(f"Vxx raw         : {Vxx.min()*1e6:+.4f} .. {Vxx.max()*1e6:+.4f} uV  (sens 2.00 uV -> rails ~2.18 uV)")
print(f"  frac railed   : {np.mean(np.abs(Vxx) > 0.95*2e-6):.2%}")
print(f"leak TG         : {itg.min()*1e12:+.1f} .. {itg.max()*1e12:+.1f} pA")
print(f"leak BG         : {ibg.min()*1e12:+.1f} .. {ibg.max()*1e12:+.1f} pA")
print(f"T_sample        : {T.min():.3f} .. {T.max():.3f} K")

# CNP = the minimum of |I| (max two-terminal resistance) at V_tg = 0
k = int(np.argmin(np.abs(I)))
print(f"\nCNP (min |I|)   : V_bg = {vbg[k]:+.4f} V, |I| = {abs(I[k])*1e9:.4f} nA, "
      f"R_2T = {1/abs(I[k]) if abs(I[k])>0 else np.inf:.4g} ohm (at I_bias-driven V unknown)")
print(f"I/I_bias at CNP : {abs(I[k])/Ibias:.4f}")
print(f"I/I_bias at ends: {abs(I[0])/Ibias:.4f} (V_bg={vbg[0]:+.2f})  "
      f"{abs(I[-1])/Ibias:.4f} (V_bg={vbg[-1]:+.2f})")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(4, 1, figsize=(8, 11), sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(vbg, I * 1e9, ".-", ms=3)
ax[0].axhline(Ibias * 1e9, ls=":", c="gray", label="I_bias 10 nA")
ax[0].axvline(vbg[k], ls="--", c="r", lw=0.8, label=f"min|I| @ {vbg[k]:+.3f} V")
ax[0].set_ylabel("I_drain (nA)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
ax[1].plot(vbg, np.abs(1 / np.where(I == 0, np.nan, I)) / 1e3, ".-", ms=3)
ax[1].set_ylabel("1/|I|  (GOhm per A)  ~ R_2T scale"); ax[1].set_yscale("log")
ax[2].plot(vbg, Vxx * 1e6, ".-", ms=3)
ax[2].axhline(2.0, ls=":", c="r"); ax[2].axhline(-2.0, ls=":", c="r")
ax[2].set_ylabel("sr1 X (uV)  [sens 2 uV]")
ax[3].plot(vbg, itg * 1e12, ".-", ms=3, label="TG")
ax[3].plot(vbg, ibg * 1e12, ".-", ms=3, label="BG")
ax[3].set_ylabel("gate leakage (pA)"); ax[3].set_xlabel("V_bg (V)"); ax[3].legend(fontsize=7)
for a in ax:
    a.axvline(vbg[k], ls="--", c="r", lw=0.6)
fig.suptitle(f"run {rid} — gatec-liveness, V_tg = 0, B = 0, T = base")
fig.tight_layout()
out = here / "hera_scratch" / f"a0_run{rid}.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)
print(f"\nwrote {out}")

ax[0].axvline(vbg[k], ls="--", c="r", lw=0.8, label=f"min|I| @ {vbg[k]:+.3f} V")
ax[0].set_ylabel("I_drain (nA)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)

ax[1].set_ylabel("1/|I|  (GOhm per A)  ~ R_2T scale"); ax[1].set_yscale("log")
ax[2].plot(vbg, Vxx * 1e6, ".-", ms=3)
ax[2].axhline(2.0, ls=":", c="r"); ax[2].axhline(-2.0, ls=":", c="r")

fig.tight_layout()

fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)

# re-run with an unclipped Rxx. Supersedes run 0 for every Rxx number.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------- preconditions
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"],
                        max_age=15, max_period=12)
_Ts = T_sample()
_B = magnet.field()
_Vsi = dc205.voltage()
_Vtg, _Vbg = k_tg.volt(), k_bg.volt()
_out_tg, _out_bg = k_2400_tg.output(), k_2400_bg.output()
print(f"pre: T_sample = {_Ts:.3f} K          (expect 1.10-1.40)")
print(f"pre: B        = {_B:+.4f} T         (expect |B| <= 0.02; this cell does not move the magnet)")
print(f"pre: V_si     = {_Vsi:+.4f} V        (expect 0; this cell does not move Si)")
print(f"pre: V_tg     = {_Vtg:+.4f} V        (expect 0.000, parked by run 0)")
print(f"pre: V_bg     = {_Vbg:+.4f} V        (expect +2.000, where run 0 ended)")
print(f"pre: outputs  = TG {_out_tg} / BG {_out_bg}")
assert 1.10 <= _Ts <= 1.40, f"T_sample {_Ts} K outside base window"
assert abs(_B) <= 0.02, f"B = {_B} T, expected ~0"
assert abs(_Vsi) <= 1e-3, f"V_si = {_Vsi} V, expected 0"
assert abs(_Vtg) <= 1e-3, f"V_tg = {_Vtg} V, expected 0"
assert bool(_out_tg) and bool(_out_bg), "Keithley source output OFF — gate sets would be inert"

# ------------------------------------------------- acquisition re-range
# Operator-authorized (Zack, this session): set sr1 sensitivity + time constant
# from the notebook, values at my discretion. Rationale on the markdown cell.
# NOT a safety surface — no validator, limit or cap is touched here.
sr1.sensitivity(1e-3)        # 2 uV -> 1 mV : 100 kOhm of Rxx headroom at 10 nA
sr0.time_constant(0.1)       # 0.3 s -> 0.1 s (dwell is gated by the SLOWEST channel)
sr1.time_constant(0.1)
for _n, _srN in (("sr0", sr0), ("sr1", sr1)):
    print(f"post-set {_n}: sens={_srN.sensitivity():.3g} V  tau={_srN.time_constant():g} s  "
          f"slope={_srN.filter_slope():g} dB/oct")
assert sr1.sensitivity() == 1e-3 and sr0.time_constant() == 0.1 and sr1.time_constant() == 0.1, \
    "lock-in re-range did not read back as commanded"
interruptible_sleep(5)       # let the new filters settle before the first point
print(f"live at V_bg={_Vbg:+.3f}: sr1 X = {sr1.X() * 1e6:+.4f} uV "
      f"(fs {abs(sr1.R()) / sr1.sensitivity():.4f})   sr0 X = {sr0.X():+.6f} V")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ the sweep
DATA_DIR = os.path.join(main_dir, "data")
VBG = spoints(2.00, -1.30, 133)   # REVERSE of run 0: starts where the gate sits, and
                                  # gives a hysteresis check against run 0 for free
DELAY = 0.7                       # 7*tau at the new tau = 0.1 s — compliant, not bent

meas_config["comments"] = ("bg-cut — back-gate cut at V_tg = 0 with sr1 re-ranged to 1 mV; "
                           "locates the CNP in Rxx and sets the Rxx scale for the gate map")
meas_config["sample_temperature:"] = _Ts
meas_config["Si (V)"] = _Vsi

s = sweep.AsyncStation(meas_config, basedir=DATA_DIR)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.Y).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.Y)
s.fp(k_2400_tg.curr).fp(k_2400_bg.curr).fp(T_sample)
s.add_comment("bg-cut")
s.add_comment(
    "1D V_bg +2.000 -> -1.300 V (reverse of run 0), 133 pts @ 25 mV | V_tg = 0.000 V | "
    "V_si = 0.000 V | B = 0 T | T = base (~1.17 K) | delay 0.7 s = 7*tau (tau 0.1 s, 24 dB/oct) | "
    "I_bias 10.0 nA (1.0 V / 100 MOhm @ 13.777 Hz) | "
    "sr0 = drain current T_0 -> B_3, Ithaco gain -1e6, sens 20 mV | "
    "sr1 = Vxx B_1-B_2, sens NOW 1 mV (was 2 uV and clipped above 218 ohm in run 0) | "
    "run 0 put the CNP at V_bg = -0.200 V from the drain-current dip; this run measures "
    "the Rxx peak there without clipping"
)
s.plot(k_bg.volt, [sr0.X, sr0.Y, sr1.X, sr1.Y,
                   k_2400_tg.curr, k_2400_bg.curr, T_sample])

res = s.sweep(k_bg.volt, VBG, delay=DELAY)
print(f"\nrun id = {res.id}   {res.datapath}")
print(f"post: V_bg = {k_bg.volt():+.4f} V   V_tg = {k_tg.volt():+.4f} V   "
      f"T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K   B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T")

four-terminal Rxx of ~100 Ω, so the **contacts dominate the two-terminal resistance**

hysteresis check against run 0 for free.

"""Run 1 (bg-cut, sr1 re-ranged) vs run 0 (clipped): CNP position, Rxx peak height,
hysteresis, noise floor at the metallic end."""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scipy.constants as cst

from hera.analysis import open_run, GateCalibration

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
r0, r1 = open_run(here / "data" / "0"), open_run(here / "data" / "1")

cal = GateCalibration.from_thicknesses(9.5e-9, 11e-9, 0.0)
print(f"c_tg = {cal.c_tg:.4g} F/m^2  -> {cal.c_tg / cst.e * 1e-16:.4g} e12 cm^-2 per V")
print(f"c_bg = {cal.c_bg:.4g} F/m^2  -> {cal.c_bg / cst.e * 1e-16:.4g} e12 cm^-2 per V")
print(f"CNP-line slope dVbg/dVtg = {-cal.c_tg / cal.c_bg:.4f}")


def get(r):
    mc = r.meta["measurement_config"]
    v = r.col("k_2400_bg_volt")
    I = r.col("sr0_X") / mc["sr0_gain"]
    Vx, Vy = r.col("sr1_X"), r.col("sr1_Y")
    return v, I, Vx / I, Vy / I     # R from the MEASURED current, not nominal bias


v0, I0, R0, Q0 = get(r0)
v1, I1, R1, Q1 = get(r1)
o1 = np.argsort(v1)                      # run 1 was swept in reverse

print(f"\nrun 0 (sens 2 uV, tau 0.3 s): Rxx {R0.min():.1f} .. {R0.max():.1f} ohm  "
      f"[CLIPPED above ~218]")
print(f"run 1 (sens 1 mV, tau 0.1 s): Rxx {R1.min():.1f} .. {R1.max():.1f} ohm")

k1 = int(np.argmax(R1))
print(f"\nCNP from Rxx peak (run 1) : V_bg = {v1[k1]:+.4f} V, Rxx_peak = {R1[k1]:.1f} ohm")
k0i = int(np.argmin(np.abs(I0)))
print(f"CNP from I dip     (run 0) : V_bg = {v0[k0i]:+.4f} V")
k1i = int(np.argmin(np.abs(I1)))
print(f"CNP from I dip     (run 1) : V_bg = {v1[k1i]:+.4f} V  -> hysteresis "
      f"{abs(v1[k1i] - v0[k0i]) * 1e3:.0f} mV between up- and down-sweeps")

# metallic-end noise: high-|n| plateau, run 1 vs run 0
for tag, v, R in (("run 0", v0, R0), ("run 1", v1, R1)):
    m = v > 1.5
    print(f"{tag} metallic end (V_bg>1.5): Rxx = {R[m].mean():.2f} +/- {R[m].std():.2f} ohm "
          f"({100 * R[m].std() / R[m].mean():.2f} % scatter, n={m.sum()})")

# quadrature -> probe-loading / phase check
print(f"\nrun 1 quadrature: |Y/X| median {np.median(np.abs(Q1 / R1)):.4f}, "
      f"max {np.max(np.abs(Q1 / R1)):.4f}  (phase drift near the CNP would show here)")

n1 = cal.density(0.0, v1) * 1e-16                      # 1e12 cm^-2, before offset
n_off = -cal.density(0.0, v1[k1]) * 1e-16
print(f"\nn_offset from the Rxx peak: {n_off:+.4f} e12 cm^-2 (intrinsic doping at V=0)")
D_cnp = cal.displacement_field(0.0, v1[k1]) * 1e-9
print(f"D at this CNP crossing    : {D_cnp:+.4f} V/nm  (this cut crosses the CNP at ~zero D)")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(3, 1, figsize=(8.5, 9.5), sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(v0, R0, ".-", ms=3, lw=0.8, label="run 0  sens 2 uV (clipped)")
ax[0].plot(v1[o1], R1[o1], ".-", ms=3, lw=0.8, label="run 1  sens 1 mV")
ax[0].axhline(218, ls=":", c="r", lw=0.8, label="run 0 clip level")
ax[0].axvline(v1[k1], ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8, label=f"CNP {v1[k1]:+.3f} V")
ax[0].set_ylabel("Rxx = Vxx / I_meas  (ohm)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_title(f"vti-02  bg-cut  V_tg=0, B=0, T=1.17 K   —   Rxx peak {R1[k1]:.0f} ohm at D~0")

ax[1].plot(v1[o1], R1[o1], ".-", ms=3, lw=0.8)
ax[1].set_yscale("log"); ax[1].set_ylabel("Rxx (ohm), log")
ax[1].axvline(v1[k1], ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8)

ax[2].plot(v0, I0 * 1e9, ".-", ms=3, lw=0.8, label="run 0")
ax[2].plot(v1[o1], I1[o1] * 1e9, ".-", ms=3, lw=0.8, label="run 1")
ax[2].set_ylabel("I_drain (nA)"); ax[2].set_xlabel("V_bg (V)  [V_tg = 0]")
ax[2].axvline(v1[k1], ls="--", c="k", lw=0.8); ax[2].legend(fontsize=7)

secx = ax[0].secondary_xaxis("top", functions=(
    lambda vb: cal.density(0.0, vb) * 1e-16 + n_off,
    lambda n: (n - n_off) * 1e16 / cal.c_bg * cst.e))
secx.set_xlabel("n  (1e12 cm^-2, geometry prior)")

fig.tight_layout()
out = here / "hera_scratch" / "a1_bgcut.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)
print(f"\nwrote {out}")

## HERA — P2: coarse (n, D) gate map — the primary stacking discriminator

Plan step **P2**. This is the measurement the call rests on. ABAB, ABCA and ABCB differ
most cheaply in **what a displacement field does to the charge-neutral point**: a Bernal
tetralayer is a band-overlapped semimetal that stays conducting under D; a rhombohedral
one opens a large single-particle gap that grows with |D| and drives R_CNP up by orders
of magnitude; a mixed ABCB stack gaps too, but — lacking inversion symmetry — not
symmetrically about D = 0. One map answers all three.

**What P1 already fixed.** Run 1 puts the CNP at **V_bg = −0.250 V at V_tg = 0**, i.e.
n_offset ≈ +3.8 × 10¹¹ cm⁻² and a crossing at D/ε₀ ≈ +0.034 V/nm — effectively zero
field. So the CNP line is `V_bg = −1.158·V_tg − 0.250` on the geometry prior, and the
peak Rxx there is **297 Ω**. Hysteresis between the up- and down-sweeps is 50 mV, one
grid step, so the gates are not charging up on us.

**Why the slow axis stops at +0.400 V, not +2.000 V.** The CNP line leaves the top-gate
box at V_bg = +0.097 V. Every row above that is pure electron doping and crosses no
neutrality point, so it carries no stacking information — it would have been 25 of 45
rows and ~25 min of fridge time for nothing. Spending that budget on **resolution
instead** gives 50 mV rows over the window that matters: ~29 distinct D values along
the CNP line, from D/ε₀ = **+0.320 V/nm down to −0.067 V/nm**.

**The one-sided-D problem, stated up front.** That window is the plan's flagged risk made
concrete. Negative D at neutrality requires V_tg < 0, and the provided top-gate limit
stops at −0.3 V — which is an operating limit I am not permitted to probe or extend. So
+D has a five-fold longer lever arm than −D. This does **not** kill the ABCB test: the
inversion-symmetry question is *where the R_CNP maximum sits*, and a symmetric ±0.067 V/nm
window straddling D = 0 is available to answer it. It does mean any ABCB verdict rests on
a short lever arm and must be hedged accordingly.

**Reading it.** Rxx is `Vxx / I_measured`, and `resistance_grids` uses the measured drain
current, so the number stays honest if the current bias sags into a resistive device.
`sr1` at 1 mV covers up to 100 kΩ; if R_CNP climbs past that at high D, the clipping is
itself the ABCA/ABCB signature and I will re-range and re-cut rather than trust the rail.

**Absolute-vs-relative caveat, recorded now.** The device card gives no Hall-bar geometry,
so Rxx in ohms cannot be converted to R per square — 297 Ω is only ~1/20 of a graphene
minimum-conductivity square, which almost certainly means the B_1–B_2 probes span well
under one square, not that the sheet is anomalously conducting. Every claim in the final
call therefore rests on **relative** changes (R_CNP(D)/R_CNP(0), activation, SdH periods),
never on an absolute R per square. Probe loading pushes the same way: R₂ₜ says the probe
contacts are ~0.4 MΩ against the SR830's 10 MΩ input, so absolute Rxx reads ~7–10 % low,
and the quadrature (|Y/X| ≤ 0.2, followed and plotted) is the tell if that worsens.

**Cost** ~34 min of measurement (2310 pts at the run-1 calibrated 0.855 s/pt, plus 1.6 s
of flyback per row); priced at 42 min to leave margin.

**Checkpoints, both stated here:** first two rows read for clipping, a dead channel, or
leakage excess — the cheapest kill is in the first minute. Then per-row digests, with the
real decision at **row ~20**, by which point the CNP line has been crossed from D = +0.32
down through +0.05 V/nm. If R_CNP is climbing steeply across those rows the answer is
already rhombohedral-like and the rest of the session goes to activation; if it is flat
at a few hundred ohms, it is Bernal-like and the Landau fan becomes the confirming
measurement.

the CNP line, from D/ε₀ = **+0.320 V/nm down to −0.067 V/nm**.

**The one-sided-D problem, stated up front.** That window is the plan's flagged risk made
concrete. Negative D at neutrality requires V_tg < 0, and the provided top-gate limit
stops at −0.3 V — which is an operating limit I am not permitted to probe or extend. So
+D has a five-fold longer lever arm than −D. This does **not** kill the ABCB test: the
inversion-symmetry question is *where the R_CNP maximum sits*, and a symmetric ±0.067 V/nm
window straddling D = 0 is available to answer it. It does mean any ABCB verdict rests on
a short lever arm and must be hedged accordingly.

**Reading it.** Rxx is `Vxx / I_measured`, and `resistance_grids` uses the measured drain
current, so the number stays honest if the current bias sags into a resistive device.
`sr1` at 1 mV covers up to 100 kΩ; if R_CNP climbs past that at high D, the clipping is
itself the ABCA/ABCB signature and I will re-range and re-cut rather than trust the rail.

**Absolute-vs-relative caveat, recorded now.** The device card gives no Hall-bar geometry,
so Rxx in ohms cannot be converted to R per square — 297 Ω is only ~1/20 of a graphene
minimum-conductivity square, which almost certainly means the B_1–B_2 probes span well
under one square, not that the sheet is anomalously conducting. Every claim in the final
call therefore rests on **relative** changes (R_CNP(D)/R_CNP(0), activation, SdH periods),
never on an absolute R per square. Probe loading pushes the same way: R₂ₜ says the probe
contacts are ~0.4 MΩ against the SR830's 10 MΩ input, so absolute Rxx reads ~7–10 % low,
and the quadrature (|Y/X| ≤ 0.2, followed and plotted) is the tell if that worsens.

**Cost** ~34 min of measurement (2310 pts at the run-1 calibrated 0.855 s/pt, plus 1.6 s
of flyback per row); priced at 42 min to leave margin.

**Checkpoints, both stated here:** first two rows read for clipping, a dead channel, or
leakage excess — the cheapest kill is in the first minute. Then per-row digests, with the
real decision at **row ~20**, by which point the CNP line has been crossed from D = +0.32
down through +0.05 V/nm. If R_CNP is climbing steeply across those rows the answer is
already rhombohedral-like and the rest of the session goes to activation; if it is flat
at a few hundred ohms, it is Bernal-like and the Landau fan becomes the confirming
measurement.

## HERA — P2 re-run: gate map without the 2D live plot (run 2 post-mortem)

**Run 2 died at point 3 of 2310** with `BrokenPipeError: [WinError 232]` raised from
`Plotter.add_point` — the live-plot subprocess fell over and took the sweep down with it.
Preconditions had all passed (T 1.170 K, B +0.0063 T, V_si 0, both Keithley outputs on,
τ 0.1 s, sr1 1 mV) and the station had already printed its 27m 21s estimate, so nothing
about the device, the gates or the measurement is implicated.

**Cause.** The extra `s.plot(k_tg.volt, sr1.X, k_bg.volt)` I added for a live map. In
`sweep/plot.py` the mesh branch runs `ax.clear()` → `griddata(...)` → `pcolormesh(...)`
**on every measured point**, re-interpolating the entire accumulated dataset each time —
O(N²) work in the child process — and it is degenerate early on, when the slow axis still
holds a single unique value. Runs 0 and 1 plotted seven 1D channels with no `z` and both
completed cleanly, which isolates the 2D call as the difference.

**Fix: drop the 2D live plot, change nothing else.** This is no loss. The rig card already
warns that `plot.png` is the live monitor and *not* the measurement for rastered or
co-swept maps — the map has to be re-formed from the TSV with `fan_grids` /
`resistance_grids` regardless, which is what the analysis does. The seven per-channel 1D
plots stay, so the operator still sees every followed value live; that is the exact
configuration already proven over two runs.

**No measurement parameter changed** — same window, same steps, same delays, same
channels. Run 2's 3-point stub stays on disk as the record of the failure.

**Lesson recorded** in `session_notes.md`: never give a long `megasweep` a 2D live plot on
this stack; a monitor crash must not be able to destroy a 34-minute measurement. The cheap
insurance is that `hera-watch` caught it within a minute — it reported `partial: 3/2310`
and exited instead of hanging, so the cost of the failure was ~1 min, not 34.

resistance there is **Rxx = 297 Ω**. On the geometry prior that anchors the session's gate
calibration: n_offset ≈ **+3.8 × 10¹¹ cm⁻²** (slightly electron-doped as grown), the CNP
line is `V_bg = −1.158·V_tg − 0.250`, and this particular crossing sits at
D/ε₀ = **+0.034 V/nm** — effectively zero displacement field. So 297 Ω is the
**D ≈ 0 reference point** that the whole stacking argument is measured against.

Three supporting reads:

- **Hysteresis is 50 mV**, one grid step, between sweeps taken in opposite directions.
  The gates are not charging up, so map rows taken minutes apart are comparable.
- **The ±12 % point-to-point wiggle is real, not noise.** Runs 0 and 1 are independent
  sweeps in opposite directions with different τ *and* different sensitivity, and their
  wiggles overlay point-for-point wherever run 0 is unclipped. That is reproducible
  mesoscopic / density-inhomogeneity structure, and it means the measurement is precise
  enough that features of this size are trustworthy.
- **A double-peaked neutrality region**: a main peak at V_bg = −0.25 V (297 Ω) and a
  second at ≈ +0.15 V (272 Ω) with a shallow dip between. Worth watching in the map — it
  is either two regions of slightly different doping between the B_1–B_2 probes, or
  genuine multi-band structure at neutrality.

**Caveat carried forward:** the device card gives no Hall-bar geometry, so these ohms are
not ohms-per-square — 297 Ω is ~1/20 of a graphene minimum-conductivity square, which
almost certainly means the B_1–B_2 probes span well under one square. Every claim in the
final call therefore rests on *relative* changes, never on absolute sheet resistance.
Probe loading pushes the same way: R₂ₜ implies ~0.4 MΩ contacts against the SR830's 10 MΩ
input, so absolute Rxx reads a few per cent low, and the quadrature is the tell if that
worsens near a gapped CNP.

**Read:** the CNP is at **V_bg = −0.250 V** at V_tg = 0, and the neutrality-point
resistance there is **Rxx = 297 Ω**. On the geometry prior that anchors the session's gate
calibration: n_offset ≈ **+3.8 × 10¹¹ cm⁻²** (slightly electron-doped as grown), the CNP
line is `V_bg = −1.158·V_tg − 0.250`, and this particular crossing sits at
D/ε₀ = **+0.034 V/nm** — effectively zero displacement field. So **297 Ω is the D ≈ 0
reference** the whole stacking argument is measured against.

Supporting reads:

- **Hysteresis is 50 mV**, one grid step, between sweeps in opposite directions. The gates
  are not charging up, so map rows taken minutes apart are comparable.
- **The point-to-point wiggle is noise, not structure.** Per-point σ is 2.2 Ω (run 0) and
  3.2 Ω (run 1); the observed run-to-run rms difference of 4.5 Ω is very close to the
  3.8 Ω that *pure independent noise* predicts, leaving only ~2 Ω (≈2 %) of reproducible
  excess. In volts that σ is ~32 nV, i.e. ~36 nV/√Hz input-referred at the 0.78 Hz ENBW —
  exactly SR830 1/f noise at 13.8 Hz. So the measurement is instrument-noise-limited and
  not drifting, and **features below ~3 % are not to be believed**. (An earlier version of
  this cell called the wiggles reproducible structure; comparing them properly against the
  noise-only prediction shows that was wrong.)
- **A double-peaked neutrality region** — peaks at V_bg = −0.25 V (297 Ω) and ≈ +0.15 V
  (272 Ω) with a 35 % dip to 194 Ω between them. That is an order of magnitude above the
  noise floor, so it is real; but it is seen in **one sweep only**, because run 0 clipped
  across exactly this region. The map's 35 independent CNP crossings are the test. If it
  persists it means either two regions of slightly different doping between the B_1–B_2
  probes, or genuine multi-band structure at neutrality — and the latter would itself be
  a stacking clue, since a Bernal tetralayer carries two bilayer-like bands with different
  masses.

**Caveat carried forward:** the device card gives no Hall-bar geometry, so these ohms are
not ohms-per-square — 297 Ω is ~1/20 of a graphene minimum-conductivity square, which
almost certainly means the B_1–B_2 probes span well under one square rather than that the
sheet is anomalously conducting. Every claim in the final call therefore rests on
*relative* changes. Probe loading pushes the same way: R₂ₜ implies ~0.4 MΩ contacts against
the SR830's 10 MΩ input, so absolute Rxx reads a few per cent low, and the quadrature
(|Y/X| ≤ 0.2) is the tell if that worsens near a gapped CNP.

"""Gate map read: re-form the fan, extract R_CNP(D) along the CNP line, measure the
CNP-line slope (session gate calibration), and test where the R_CNP minimum sits.

R_CNP(D) is the primary ABAB / ABCA / ABCB discriminator:
  ABAB  - band-overlapped semimetal, stays conducting, weak D dependence
  ABCA  - inversion symmetric, gap opens with |D| -> R_CNP MINIMUM exactly at D = 0
  ABCB  - no inversion symmetry, built-in gap -> R_CNP minimum DISPLACED from D = 0
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scipy.constants as cst

from hera.analysis import open_run, fan_grids, resistance_grids, GateCalibration

rid = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 3
here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
r = open_run(here / "data" / str(rid))
print(f"run {rid}: {r.meta['type']}  {r.recipe}  rows={r.rows}  interrupted={r.interrupted}")

fan = fan_grids(r)
rg = resistance_grids(fan)
Vtg = fan.grid("k_2400_tg_volt")          # (nrows, nfast)
Vbg = fan.slow                            # (nrows,)
Rxx = np.abs(rg.R["sr1"])                 # (nrows, nfast), signed -> magnitude
Ig = rg.current
print(f"grid: {fan.nrows} rows x {fan.nfast} fast   Rxx {Rxx.min():.1f} .. {Rxx.max():.1f} ohm")
print(f"current: {Ig.min()*1e9:.3f} .. {Ig.max()*1e9:.3f} nA")

cal = GateCalibration.from_thicknesses(9.5e-9, 11e-9, 0.0)

# --- per-row CNP: the Rxx maximum along the fast (V_tg) axis -----------------
kpk = np.argmax(Rxx, axis=1)
Rpk = Rxx[np.arange(fan.nrows), kpk]
Vtg_pk = Vtg[np.arange(fan.nrows), kpk]
# rows whose peak sits on a boundary never actually crossed the CNP
edge = (kpk <= 1) | (kpk >= fan.nfast - 2)
print(f"\nrows with an interior CNP peak: {(~edge).sum()} of {fan.nrows} "
      f"(boundary rows excluded: {edge.sum()})")

# --- measured CNP-line slope = the session gate calibration ------------------
A = np.polyfit(Vbg[~edge], Vtg_pk[~edge], 1)
slope_meas = A[0]                       # dV_tg/dV_bg along the CNP line
ratio_meas = -1.0 / slope_meas          # = c_tg / c_bg
ratio_geom = cal.c_tg / cal.c_bg
print(f"CNP line fit : V_tg = {A[0]:+.4f}*V_bg {A[1]:+.4f}")
print(f"  measured c_tg/c_bg = {ratio_meas:.4f}   geometry prior = {ratio_geom:.4f}   "
      f"({100*(ratio_meas/ratio_geom-1):+.1f} %)")

# absolute scale still from geometry; only the RATIO is measured here
c_bg_cal = cal.c_tg / ratio_meas
cal_s = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal.c_tg, c_bg=c_bg_cal)
D_pk = cal_s.displacement_field(Vtg_pk, Vbg) * 1e-9        # V/nm
n_pk = cal_s.density(Vtg_pk, Vbg) * 1e-16                  # 1e12 cm^-2 (should be ~const)
print(f"  n along the fitted CNP line: {n_pk.mean():+.4f} +/- {n_pk.std():.4f} e12 cm^-2 "
      f"(this is n_offset)")

ok = ~edge
order = np.argsort(D_pk[ok])
Dv, Rv = D_pk[ok][order], Rpk[ok][order]
print(f"\nD range covered along the CNP line: {Dv.min():+.4f} .. {Dv.max():+.4f} V/nm")
print(f"R_CNP range                       : {Rv.min():.0f} .. {Rv.max():.0f} ohm "
      f"(ratio {Rv.max()/Rv.min():.1f}x)")

kmin = int(np.argmin(Rv))
print(f"\nR_CNP MINIMUM at D/eps0 = {Dv[kmin]:+.4f} V/nm  (R = {Rv[kmin]:.0f} ohm)")
print("   ABCA (inversion symmetric) requires the minimum at D = 0;")
print("   ABCB (no inversion) puts it at D != 0;")
print("   ABAB would show little D dependence at all.")

# quadratic fit near the minimum -> sub-step estimate of D_min
sel = np.abs(Dv - Dv[kmin]) < 0.12
if sel.sum() >= 4:
    q = np.polyfit(Dv[sel], np.log10(Rv[sel]), 2)
    D_min_fit = -q[1] / (2 * q[0])
    print(f"   quadratic fit on log10(R) near the minimum: D_min = {D_min_fit:+.4f} V/nm "
          f"({sel.sum()} pts)")

for tag, lo, hi in (("+D", 0.0, 1.0), ("-D", -1.0, 0.0)):
    m = (Dv >= lo) & (Dv < hi) if tag == "+D" else (Dv > lo) & (Dv <= hi)
    if m.sum():
        print(f"   {tag}: {m.sum()} pts, |D| up to {np.abs(Dv[m]).max():.3f} V/nm, "
              f"R_CNP up to {Rv[m].max():.0f} ohm")

# --- figures ----------------------------------------------------------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 9))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1])

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
pc = ax.pcolormesh(Vtg, np.tile(Vbg[:, None], (1, fan.nfast)), np.log10(Rxx),
                   shading="nearest", cmap="magma")
ax.plot(Vtg_pk[~edge], Vbg[~edge], "c.-", ms=4, lw=0.8, label="CNP (Rxx max)")
ax.set_xlabel("V_tg (V)"); ax.set_ylabel("V_bg (V)")
ax.set_title(f"run {rid} — log10 Rxx (ohm),  B = 0, T = base")
fig.colorbar(pc, ax=ax, label="log10 Rxx"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
nn = cal_s.density(Vtg, np.tile(Vbg[:, None], (1, fan.nfast))) * 1e-16
DD = cal_s.displacement_field(Vtg, np.tile(Vbg[:, None], (1, fan.nfast))) * 1e-9
pc = ax.pcolormesh(nn, DD, np.log10(Rxx), shading="nearest", cmap="magma")
ax.plot(n_pk[~edge], D_pk[~edge], "c.-", ms=4, lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("n  (1e12 cm^-2)"); ax.set_ylabel("D/eps0  (V/nm)")
ax.set_title("same map in (n, D)")
fig.colorbar(pc, ax=ax, label="log10 Rxx")

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
ax.plot(Dv, Rv, "o-", ms=5, lw=1.2)
ax.axvline(0.0, ls="--", c="k", lw=1.0, label="D = 0")
ax.axvline(Dv[kmin], ls=":", c="r", lw=1.2, label=f"R_CNP min at {Dv[kmin]:+.3f} V/nm")
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("D/eps0  (V/nm)  along the CNP line")
ax.set_ylabel("R_CNP  (ohm)")
ax.set_title("R at charge neutrality vs displacement field — the stacking discriminator")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=0.3, which="both")

fig.tight_layout()
out = here / "hera_scratch" / f"a3_gatemap_run{rid}.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)
print(f"\nwrote {out}")

np.savez(here / "hera_scratch" / f"a3_gatemap_run{rid}.npz",
         D=Dv, R=Rv, Vtg_pk=Vtg_pk, Vbg=Vbg, edge=edge,
         ratio_meas=ratio_meas, n_offset=n_pk.mean())

ratio_geom = cal.c_tg / cal.c_bg
print(f"CNP line fit : V_tg = {A[0]:+.4f}*V_bg {A[1]:+.4f}")
print(f"  measured c_tg/c_bg = {ratio_meas:.4f}   geometry prior = {ratio_geom:.4f}   "
      f"({100*(ratio_meas/ratio_geom-1):+.1f} %)")

# absolute scale still from geometry; only the RATIO is measured here
c_bg_cal = cal.c_tg / ratio_meas
cal_s = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal.c_tg, c_bg=c_bg_cal)
D_pk = cal_s.displacement_field(Vtg_pk, Vbg) * 1e-9        # V/nm
n_pk = cal_s.density(Vtg_pk, Vbg) * 1e-16                  # 1e12 cm^-2 (should be ~const)
print(f"  n along the fitted CNP line: {n_pk.mean():+.4f} +/- {n_pk.std():.4f} e12 cm^-2 "
      f"(this is n_offset)")

ok = ~edge
order = np.argsort(D_pk[ok])
Dv, Rv = D_pk[ok][order], Rpk[ok][order]
print(f"\nD range covered along the CNP line: {Dv.min():+.4f} .. {Dv.max():+.4f} V/nm")
print(f"R_CNP range                       : {Rv.min():.0f} .. {Rv.max():.0f} ohm "
      f"(ratio {Rv.max()/Rv.min():.1f}x)")

kmin = int(np.argmin(Rv))
print(f"\nR_CNP MINIMUM at D/eps0 = {Dv[kmin]:+.4f} V/nm  (R = {Rv[kmin]:.0f} ohm)")
print("   ABCA (inversion symmetric) requires the minimum at D = 0;")
print("   ABCB (no inversion) puts it at D != 0;")
print("   ABAB would show little D dependence at all.")

# quadratic fit near the minimum -> sub-step estimate of D_min
sel = np.abs(Dv - Dv[kmin]) < 0.12
if sel.sum() >= 4:
    q = np.polyfit(Dv[sel], np.log10(Rv[sel]), 2)
    D_min_fit = -q[1] / (2 * q[0])
    print(f"   quadratic fit on log10(R) near the minimum: D_min = {D_min_fit:+.4f} V/nm "
          f"({sel.sum()} pts)")

for tag, lo, hi in (("+D", 0.0, 1.0), ("-D", -1.0, 0.0)):
    m = (Dv >= lo) & (Dv < hi) if tag == "+D" else (Dv > lo) & (Dv <= hi)
    if m.sum():
        print(f"   {tag}: {m.sum()} pts, |D| up to {np.abs(Dv[m]).max():.3f} V/nm, "
              f"R_CNP up to {Rv[m].max():.0f} ohm")

# --- figures ----------------------------------------------------------------
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(12, 9))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, height_ratios=[1.15, 1])

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
pc = ax.pcolormesh(Vtg, np.tile(Vbg[:, None], (1, fan.nfast)), np.log10(Rxx),
                   shading="nearest", cmap="magma")
ax.plot(Vtg_pk[~edge], Vbg[~edge], "c.-", ms=4, lw=0.8, label="CNP (Rxx max)")
ax.set_xlabel("V_tg (V)"); ax.set_ylabel("V_bg (V)")
ax.set_title(f"run {rid} — log10 Rxx (ohm),  B = 0, T = base")
fig.colorbar(pc, ax=ax, label="log10 Rxx"); ax.legend(fontsize=7)

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
nn = cal_s.density(Vtg, np.tile(Vbg[:, None], (1, fan.nfast))) * 1e-16
DD = cal_s.displacement_field(Vtg, np.tile(Vbg[:, None], (1, fan.nfast))) * 1e-9
pc = ax.pcolormesh(nn, DD, np.log10(Rxx), shading="nearest", cmap="magma")
ax.plot(n_pk[~edge], D_pk[~edge], "c.-", ms=4, lw=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel("n  (1e12 cm^-2)"); ax.set_ylabel("D/eps0  (V/nm)")
ax.set_title("same map in (n, D)")
fig.colorbar(pc, ax=ax, label="log10 Rxx")

ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :])
ax.plot(Dv, Rv, "o-", ms=5, lw=1.2)
ax.axvline(0.0, ls="--", c="k", lw=1.0, label="D = 0")
ax.axvline(Dv[kmin], ls=":", c="r", lw=1.2, label=f"R_CNP min at {Dv[kmin]:+.3f} V/nm")
ax.set_yscale("log")
ax.set_xlabel("D/eps0  (V/nm)  along the CNP line")
ax.set_ylabel("R_CNP  (ohm)")
ax.set_title("R at charge neutrality vs displacement field — the stacking discriminator")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.grid(alpha=0.3, which="both")

fig.tight_layout()
out = here / "hera_scratch" / f"a3_gatemap_run{rid}.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)
print(f"\nwrote {out}")

np.savez(here / "hera_scratch" / f"a3_gatemap_run{rid}.npz",
         D=Dv, R=Rv, Vtg_pk=Vtg_pk, Vbg=Vbg, edge=edge,
         ratio_meas=ratio_meas, n_offset=n_pk.mean())

I'll wait for the completion notification rather than continue polling.

**Current state, for the record:**

The gate map (run 3) is at row 17/35 and behaving exactly as designed. The physics result so far is unambiguous: **R at charge neutrality rises ~10× under displacement field**, from 297 Ω at D ≈ 0 to ~2.9 kΩ above D/ε₀ ≈ 0.2 V/nm, where it saturates. A Bernal ABAB tetralayer is a band-overlapped semimetal and should do essentially none of that, so ABAB is now the disfavoured hypothesis and the open question is ABCA versus ABCB.

Rows 18–27 are the ones that decide it — they carry the CNP line from D = +0.09 through zero to −0.05. ABCA has inversion symmetry, so its R_CNP minimum must sit exactly at D = 0; ABCB's built-in gap displaces the minimum to finite D. The −D lever arm is 5× shorter than +D because the provided −0.3 V top-gate limit bounds it, and that constraint will be stated in the final call rather than papered over.

Queued behind the map, in order:
1. **P3 — CNP-line multisweep** at base T (~2 min), using the map's *measured* capacitance ratio rather than the geometry prior, for a fine-grained R_CNP(D).
2. **P4 — Landau fan** at fixed D on a `field_invB` grid (~1.7 h): SdH tone count gives the Fermi-pocket number (1 = ABCA-like single quartic band, 2 = ABAB/ABCB), and the Onsager frequency gives the first *absolute* density calibration — everything so far rests on an unverified geometry prior.
3. **P5 — T-ladder** last, since cooling back to base is passive and slow. Activation converts R_CNP(D) into Δ(D) in meV, and it's the one measurement immune to the unknown Hall-bar geometry factor.

I'll send Zack the checkpoint verdict when the map lands.

input.content:
"""Robust R_CNP(D) and the inversion-symmetry test.

Improvements over a4's first pass:
  * parabolic sub-step interpolation of the CNP peak position/height
  * the CNP-line fit uses only rows where the ridge is UNAMBIGUOUS (high |D|,
    tall narrow peak), then extrapolates into the low-|D| region
  * propagates the fitted-slope uncertainty into the location of D = 0
  * explicit +D vs -D comparison at matched |D|
  * flags rows where the neutrality region is double-peaked
"""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scipy.constants as cst

from hera.analysis import open_run, fan_grids, resistance_grids, GateCalibration

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
r = open_run(here / "data" / "3")
fan = fan_grids(r)
rg = resistance_grids(fan)
Vtg = fan.grid("k_2400_tg_volt")
Vbg = fan.slow
Rxx = np.abs(rg.R["sr1"])
nrows, nfast = Rxx.shape
dvtg = Vtg[0, 1] - Vtg[0, 0]

# ---- per-row peak: parabolic interpolation on the 3 points around argmax ----
kpk = np.argmax(Rxx, axis=1)
Vpk = np.empty(nrows)
Rpk = np.empty(nrows)
for i, k in enumerate(kpk):
    if 0 < k < nfast - 1:
        y0, y1, y2 = Rxx[i, k - 1], Rxx[i, k], Rxx[i, k + 1]
        den = (y0 - 2 * y1 + y2)
        d = 0.5 * (y0 - y2) / den if den != 0 else 0.0
        d = np.clip(d, -1, 1)
        Vpk[i] = Vtg[i, k] + d * dvtg
        Rpk[i] = y1 - 0.25 * (y0 - y2) * d
    else:
        Vpk[i], Rpk[i] = Vtg[i, k], Rxx[i, k]
edge = (kpk <= 1) | (kpk >= nfast - 2)

# ---- double-peak flag: a second local max within 80% of the main one --------
def n_strong_peaks(row, frac=0.80):
    m = row.max()
    pk = [j for j in range(1, nfast - 1)
          if row[j] > row[j - 1] and row[j] >= row[j + 1] and row[j] > frac * m]
    return len(pk)

npk = np.array([n_strong_peaks(Rxx[i]) for i in range(nrows)])

# ---- CNP-line fit on the UNAMBIGUOUS rows only ------------------------------
contrast = Rpk / np.median(Rxx, axis=1)
good = (~edge) & (npk == 1) & (contrast > 1.6)
print(f"rows total {nrows} | interior {(~edge).sum()} | single-peaked {(npk == 1).sum()} | "
      f"used for the line fit {good.sum()}")
print(f"rows flagged DOUBLE-peaked: {list(np.round(Vbg[npk > 1], 3))}")

A, cov = np.polyfit(Vbg[good], Vpk[good], 1, cov=True)
slope, icept = A
sl_err = np.sqrt(cov[0, 0])
ratio = -1.0 / slope                                   # c_tg / c_bg
ratio_err = abs(sl_err / slope ** 2) * ratio ** 0 / abs(slope) * 0 + abs(sl_err) / slope ** 2
cal_g = GateCalibration.from_thicknesses(9.5e-9, 11e-9, 0.0)
print(f"\nCNP line (strong rows): V_tg = {slope:+.5f}(+/-{sl_err:.5f})*V_bg {icept:+.5f}")
print(f"  measured c_tg/c_bg = {ratio:.4f} +/- {ratio_err:.4f}   "
      f"(geometry prior {cal_g.c_tg / cal_g.c_bg:.4f})")

cal_s = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal_g.c_tg, c_bg=cal_g.c_tg / ratio)
D = cal_s.displacement_field(Vpk, Vbg) * 1e-9
use = ~edge
o = np.argsort(D[use])
Dv, Rv, npv = D[use][o], Rpk[use][o], npk[use][o]

# where is D = 0 on the CNP line, and how uncertain is it?
Vtg_D0 = icept / (1.0 - slope * ratio) if abs(1.0 - slope * ratio) > 1e-9 else np.nan
# sensitivity of D_min location to the fitted ratio: recompute D with ratio +/- err
for rr, tag in ((ratio - ratio_err, "-1sig"), (ratio + ratio_err, "+1sig")):
    c2 = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal_g.c_tg, c_bg=cal_g.c_tg / rr)
    D2 = c2.displacement_field(Vpk, Vbg) * 1e-9
    print(f"  D of the R_CNP argmin with ratio {tag}: {D2[use][np.argmin(Rpk[use])]:+.4f} V/nm")

kmin = int(np.argmin(Rv))
sel = np.abs(Dv - Dv[kmin]) < 0.10
q = np.polyfit(Dv[sel], np.log10(Rv[sel]), 2)
D_min = -q[1] / (2 * q[0])
print(f"\nR_CNP min: argmin at D = {Dv[kmin]:+.4f} V/nm (R = {Rv[kmin]:.0f} ohm); "
      f"parabola on log10 R over {sel.sum()} pts -> D_min = {D_min:+.4f} V/nm")
print(f"R_CNP range {Rv.min():.0f} .. {Rv.max():.0f} ohm  ({Rv.max()/Rv.min():.1f}x)")
print(f"D covered: {Dv.min():+.4f} .. {Dv.max():+.4f} V/nm "
      f"(-D lever arm is {abs(Dv.min())/Dv.max():.2f} of +D)")

# ---- +D vs -D at matched |D| about the fitted minimum -----------------------
print(f"\nsymmetry about D_min = {D_min:+.4f} V/nm:")
dd = Dv - D_min
neg = dd < 0
print(f"  {'|dD|':>7}  {'R(-D)':>8}  {'R(+D)':>8}   ratio")
for target in (0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08):
    if (-dd[neg]).max() < target:
        continue
    rn = np.interp(target, -dd[neg][::-1], Rv[neg][::-1])
    rp = np.interp(target, dd[~neg], Rv[~neg])
    print(f"  {target:7.3f}  {rn:8.0f}  {rp:8.0f}   {rp/rn:5.2f}")
print(f"  (per-point noise ~3 %; anything within ~1.1 is consistent with symmetric)")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5))
ax[0].plot(Dv, Rv, "o-", ms=5, lw=1.2, color="C0")
m2 = npv > 1
ax[0].plot(Dv[m2], Rv[m2], "s", ms=9, mfc="none", mec="r", label="double-peaked row")
ax[0].axvline(0, ls="--", c="k", lw=1.0, label="D = 0")
ax[0].axvline(D_min, ls=":", c="r", lw=1.2, label=f"R_CNP min {D_min:+.3f} V/nm")
ax[0].set_yscale("log"); ax[0].set_xlabel("D/eps0 (V/nm)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("R_CNP (ohm)")
ax[0].set_title("R at neutrality vs D  (run 3, B=0, T=1.17 K)")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].grid(alpha=0.3, which="both")

ax[1].plot(np.abs(dd[neg]), Rv[neg], "o-", ms=5, label="D < D_min")
ax[1].plot(dd[~neg], Rv[~neg], "s-", ms=5, label="D > D_min")
ax[1].set_yscale("log"); ax[1].set_xlim(0, 0.10)
ax[1].set_xlabel("|D - D_min|  (V/nm)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("R_CNP (ohm)")
ax[1].set_title("folded about the minimum — inversion-symmetry test")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].grid(alpha=0.3, which="both")
fig.tight_layout()
out = here / "hera_scratch" / "a4_symmetry.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)
print(f"\nwrote {out}")
np.savez(here / "hera_scratch" / "a4_symmetry.npz", D=Dv, R=Rv, npk=npv,
         ratio=ratio, ratio_err=ratio_err, D_min=D_min, slope=slope, icept=icept)

  * parabolic sub-step interpolation of the CNP peak position/height
  * the CNP-line fit uses only rows where the ridge is UNAMBIGUOUS (high |D|,
    tall narrow peak), then extrapolates into the low-|D| region
  * propagates the fitted-slope uncertainty into the location of D = 0
  * explicit +D vs -D comparison at matched |D|
  * flags rows where the neutrality region is double-peaked
"""
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import scipy.constants as cst

from hera.analysis import open_run, fan_grids, resistance_grids, GateCalibration

here = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
r = open_run(here / "data" / "3")
fan = fan_grids(r)
rg = resistance_grids(fan)
Vtg = fan.grid("k_2400_tg_volt")
Vbg = fan.slow
Rxx = np.abs(rg.R["sr1"])
nrows, nfast = Rxx.shape
dvtg = Vtg[0, 1] - Vtg[0, 0]

# ---- per-row peak: parabolic interpolation on the 3 points around argmax ----
kpk = np.argmax(Rxx, axis=1)
Vpk = np.empty(nrows)
Rpk = np.empty(nrows)
for i, k in enumerate(kpk):
    if 0 < k < nfast - 1:
        y0, y1, y2 = Rxx[i, k - 1], Rxx[i, k], Rxx[i, k + 1]
        den = (y0 - 2 * y1 + y2)
        d = 0.5 * (y0 - y2) / den if den != 0 else 0.0
        d = np.clip(d, -1, 1)
        Vpk[i] = Vtg[i, k] + d * dvtg
        Rpk[i] = y1 - 0.25 * (y0 - y2) * d
    else:
        Vpk[i], Rpk[i] = Vtg[i, k], Rxx[i, k]
edge = (kpk <= 1) | (kpk >= nfast - 2)

# ---- double-peak flag: a second local max within 80% of the main one --------
def n_strong_peaks(row, frac=0.80):
    m = row.max()
    pk = [j for j in range(1, nfast - 1)
          if row[j] > row[j - 1] and row[j] >= row[j + 1] and row[j] > frac * m]
    return len(pk)

npk = np.array([n_strong_peaks(Rxx[i]) for i in range(nrows)])

# ---- CNP-line fit on the UNAMBIGUOUS rows only ------------------------------
contrast = Rpk / np.median(Rxx, axis=1)
good = (~edge) & (npk == 1) & (contrast > 1.6)
print(f"rows total {nrows} | interior {(~edge).sum()} | single-peaked {(npk == 1).sum()} | "
      f"used for the line fit {good.sum()}")
print(f"rows flagged DOUBLE-peaked: {list(np.round(Vbg[npk > 1], 3))}")

A, cov = np.polyfit(Vbg[good], Vpk[good], 1, cov=True)
slope, icept = A
sl_err = np.sqrt(cov[0, 0])
ratio = -1.0 / slope                                   # c_tg / c_bg
ratio_err = abs(sl_err / slope ** 2) * ratio ** 0 / abs(slope) * 0 + abs(sl_err) / slope ** 2
cal_g = GateCalibration.from_thicknesses(9.5e-9, 11e-9, 0.0)
print(f"\nCNP line (strong rows): V_tg = {slope:+.5f}(+/-{sl_err:.5f})*V_bg {icept:+.5f}")
print(f"  measured c_tg/c_bg = {ratio:.4f} +/- {ratio_err:.4f}   "
      f"(geometry prior {cal_g.c_tg / cal_g.c_bg:.4f})")

cal_s = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal_g.c_tg, c_bg=cal_g.c_tg / ratio)
D = cal_s.displacement_field(Vpk, Vbg) * 1e-9
use = ~edge
o = np.argsort(D[use])
Dv, Rv, npv = D[use][o], Rpk[use][o], npk[use][o]

# where is D = 0 on the CNP line, and how uncertain is it?
Vtg_D0 = icept / (1.0 - slope * ratio) if abs(1.0 - slope * ratio) > 1e-9 else np.nan
# sensitivity of D_min location to the fitted ratio: recompute D with ratio +/- err
for rr, tag in ((ratio - ratio_err, "-1sig"), (ratio + ratio_err, "+1sig")):
    c2 = GateCalibration(c_tg=cal_g.c_tg, c_bg=cal_g.c_tg / rr)
    D2 = c2.displacement_field(Vpk, Vbg) * 1e-9
    print(f"  D of the R_CNP argmin with ratio {tag}: {D2[use][np.argmin(Rpk[use])]:+.4f} V/nm")

kmin = int(np.argmin(Rv))
sel = np.abs(Dv - Dv[kmin]) < 0.10
q = np.polyfit(Dv[sel], np.log10(Rv[sel]), 2)
D_min = -q[1] / (2 * q[0])
print(f"\nR_CNP min: argmin at D = {Dv[kmin]:+.4f} V/nm (R = {Rv[kmin]:.0f} ohm); "
      f"parabola on log10 R over {sel.sum()} pts -> D_min = {D_min:+.4f} V/nm")
print(f"R_CNP range {Rv.min():.0f} .. {Rv.max():.0f} ohm  ({Rv.max()/Rv.min():.1f}x)")
print(f"D covered: {Dv.min():+.4f} .. {Dv.max():+.4f} V/nm "
      f"(-D lever arm is {abs(Dv.min())/Dv.max():.2f} of +D)")

# ---- +D vs -D at matched |D| about the fitted minimum -----------------------
print(f"\nsymmetry about D_min = {D_min:+.4f} V/nm:")
dd = Dv - D_min
neg = dd < 0
print(f"  {'|dD|':>7}  {'R(-D)':>8}  {'R(+D)':>8}   ratio")
for target in (0.02, 0.04, 0.06, 0.08):
    if (-dd[neg]).max() < target:
        continue
    rn = np.interp(target, -dd[neg][::-1], Rv[neg][::-1])
    rp = np.interp(target, dd[~neg], Rv[~neg])
    print(f"  {target:7.3f}  {rn:8.0f}  {rp:8.0f}   {rp/rn:5.2f}")
print(f"  (per-point noise ~3 %; anything within ~1.1 is consistent with symmetric)")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13, 5))
ax[0].plot(Dv, Rv, "o-", ms=5, lw=1.2, color="C0")
m2 = npv > 1
ax[0].plot(Dv[m2], Rv[m2], "s", ms=9, mfc="none", mec="r", label="double-peaked row")
ax[0].axvline(0, ls="--", c="k", lw=1.0, label="D = 0")
ax[0].axvline(D_min, ls=":", c="r", lw=1.2, label=f"R_CNP min {D_min:+.3f} V/nm")
ax[0].set_yscale("log"); ax[0].set_xlabel("D/eps0 (V/nm)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("R_CNP (ohm)")
ax[0].set_title("R at neutrality vs D  (run 3, B=0, T=1.17 K)")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8); ax[0].grid(alpha=0.3, which="both")

ax[1].plot(np.abs(dd[neg]), Rv[neg], "o-", ms=5, label="D < D_min")
ax[1].plot(dd[~neg], Rv[~neg], "s-", ms=5, label="D > D_min")
ax[1].set_yscale("log"); ax[1].set_xlim(0, 0.10)
ax[1].set_xlabel("|D - D_min|  (V/nm)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("R_CNP (ohm)")
ax[1].set_title("folded about the minimum — inversion-symmetry test")
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8); ax[1].grid(alpha=0.3, which="both")
fig.tight_layout()
out = here / "hera_scratch" / "a4_symmetry.png"
fig.savefig(out, dpi=110)
print(f"\nwrote {out}")
np.savez(here / "hera_scratch" / "a4_symmetry.npz", D=Dv, R=Rv, npk=npv,
         ratio=ratio, ratio_err=ratio_err, D_min=D_min, slope=slope, icept=icept)

def fan_grids(run: "str | Path | Run", columns: list[str] | None = None) -> FanGrids:
    """Re-form a 2D fan into per-column grids, keeping only complete slow rows.

    `run` is a run directory or an already-loaded `Run`. `nfast` comes from
    metadata (never hardcoded); trailing rows of an in-progress sweep are
    dropped via `nrows = total // nfast`. `columns` restricts which columns
    are retained in `.data`/`.cols` (the reshape is unaffected).
    """
    r = run if isinstance(run, Run) else open_run(run)
    nfast = _fast_count(r.meta)
    nrows = r.data.shape[0] // nfast
    data = r.data[: nrows * nfast]
    cols = r.cols
    if columns is not None:
        keep = [r.cols.index(c) for c in columns]
        data = data[:, keep]
        cols = list(columns)
    return FanGrids(nrows=nrows, nfast=nfast, cols=cols, data=data,
                    meta=r.meta, slow_param=_slow_param(r.meta))
